title: Microbot Medical Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-10
summary: Microbot Medical Inc. (ticker: MBOT, NASDAQ Capital Market) filed a Form 8-K on April 10, 2026, disclosing an update to its At the Market (ATM) offering program with H.C. Wainwright & Co., allowing the company to sell common stock up to an aggregate offering price of $39,230,691. This is a routine corporate securities filing with no relevance to market structure or macro catalysts.
key_points: Company: Microbot Medical Inc., a medical device company based in Hingham, MA, trading on NASDAQ Capital Market under ticker MBOT.
ATM Program: The company maintains an At the Market offering agreement with H.C. Wainwright & Co., LLC, as amended on July 1, 2024.
Offering Size: Up to $39,230,691 in aggregate offering price of common stock.
Registration: The offering is tied to a shelf registration statement on Form S-3 (File No. 333-275634).
Legal Opinion: Mintz, Levin, Cohn, Ferris, Glovsky and Popeo, P.C. provided a legality opinion for the ATM shares.
Signed by: Harel Gadot, CEO, President and Chairman, on April 10, 2026.
